fact: BINA Mauritanie, funded by the Islamic Development Bank, is setting up the BINA business incubator in Nouakchott, with capacity building for 100 startups and 100 micro-enterprises over about 15 months.
title: Mise en place de l'incubateur d'entreprises « BINA » pour l'entrepreneuriat en Mauritanie - Composante 2 & 4
